verdict.rationale: Docs confirm multi-location companies can have different pay schedules by location/job type and that regular payrolls are pre-generated from a company's pay schedule, but there's no explicit documentation of setting up weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly schedule types or configuring them per team/department in the ops UI. missing for 10: explicit list of supported pay schedule frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly), a documented UI/API flow for creating/editing multiple distinct schedules per team, and independent confirmation of this multi-schedule setup working in practice.
